mapper.select: SELECT post_id, user_id, post_title, post_content, created_at, updated_at, view_count FROM post WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE post SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = updated_at
